metadata.expansion_reason: The existing error_null_face case validates the public C-shaped null-face call but its harness short-circuits before the exported C ABI and WASM handle wrappers. This dedicated case keeps the public null-face shape and attaches the maintained font only to select those ABI routes, where handle 0 must be rejected.
metadata.oracle_verdict: Pinned FreeType freetype/src/base/ftobjs.c:3572-3596 normalizes the dimensions and deliberately defers face validation to FT_Request_Size; freetype/src/base/ftobjs.c:3446-3447 returns FT_Err_Invalid_Face_Handle for the null face.
